ambiguity_assessment: All66 observed false permissions carry explicit nonexecution/quotation/hypothetical/history or multi-action structure; no label reclassification needed. Blanket words alone can still overreject hypothetical discussions combined with a later actualcommand,so supported scope must remain exactly one positive device action.
generic_guard_candidates: Negated volition:并非要/并不要求/暂不执行/取消本次 around the actual action
Hypothesis:假想/假设/若设定情境 plus action,not an actualrequest
Quotation purpose:这几个字/作为引用/摘录/复写/抄到...里 governing devicecommand text
Historical completion query:此前/历史/先前 + 是否/有没有/完成
Sequential connectors:完成后/顺手/处理两件事 with actions onboth sides; unknown multiobject descriptions rejected
